summary: Validates a four-byte chunk-type header pointed to by a2. Each byte must satisfy 0x29 <= v <= 0x7A and must not fall in the gap 0x5A < v < 0x61. On the first invalid byte the function calls DoubleBufferInit(a1, "invalid chunk type") and returns its result. When all four bytes are valid it returns the fourth byte a2[3].

operations.description: Validate a2[0]: fail unless 0x29 <= v <= 0x7A and v is not in the gap 0x5A < v < 0x61.
Validate a2[1] with the same chunk-type range test; on failure fall through to the error report.
Validate a2[2] with the same chunk-type range test; on failure fall through to the error report.
Validate a2[3] with the same chunk-type range test; on failure fall through to the error report.
Report an invalid chunk: call DoubleBufferInit(a1, "invalid chunk type"), the message string being the read-only global aInvalidChunkTy at 0x005AFB18, and return its result.
Return a2[3] (the fourth chunk-type byte) once all four bytes have passed validation.

unresolved: Meaning of the four-byte chunk type and how a2 is laid out in the caller sub_518FCF is unknown; the header appears archive/chunk related.
DoubleBufferInit semantics and why the error is routed through it are not established from this function alone.
